sources.name: OverTheCap
sources.scope: 2025 Season History: base salary, annual cash and cap charge

notes: Reported season cash is a proxy for calendar-year wages; actual W-2 payment timing, incentives and postseason pay are not available.
Other cash is modeled as service compensation allocated by duty days. Option/roster bonus sourcing needs individual review.
Prior signing-bonus cap proration is not new cash.
